test_se3_exp_map_output_format: test that se3_exp_map produces valid SE3 matrices with determinant 1 and correct last column
test_se3_exp_map_singularity: test se3_exp_map handles numerically unstable inputs with near-zero L2 norm vectors and finite gradients
test_se3_log_map_singularity: test se3_log_map handles transforms with tiny rotation angles and translations near the identity matrix
test_se3_exp_log_roundtrip: test that se3_exp_map and se3_log_map are inverses by converting transforms to log and back
test_se3_input_validation: test that se3_exp_map and se3_log_map raise ValueError on incorrect tensor shapes or illegal values
